name: computer-use-linux
description: Linux desktop control: AT-SPI accessibility trees, screenshots, compositor window targeting, and Wayland/X11 input.

interface.shortDescription: Control Linux desktop apps through accessibility trees and native input.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and control local Linux applications through AT-SPI, desktop portals, and compositor-aware window targeting on GNOME, KDE, Hyprland, niri, i3, COSMIC, and X11. Screenshots and accessibility trees can contain private data, and input reaches real applications.
